residue.text: Interface ablation must keep P1 unloading and P2 inspection functional while removing only P2 consumption of P1 arrivals. No permitted control supplies that condition: their sole rack establishes inspection eligibility upon arrival. Broken connection and disconnected co-presence are unavailable. Blocking unloading disables P1 output; withholding inspection disables P2 processing. Neither identifies the link effect.

Feasible probe: replay P2 alone with P1 idle and compare ledger unloads, correct releases, rack occupancy and separate occupied intervals against the intact candidate. Material-dependency account predicts three initial releases alone versus twelve intact; P2-only sufficiency predicts twelve alone. Three alone defeats sufficiency, without identifying a functional-parent link-ablation effect. P1 alone can hand unload B4 and B5 during 0-2, then idle with the rack full: two source unloads, two transfer minutes, zero releases. Both parent-alone conditions fail demand and cannot rank as successes.

Charge blocked unloading to the transfer clerk and correction to the inspection clerk; record remaining allowances and rack occupancy. B9 packing mark is not a correct release. All performance figures are finite-model predictions, not observed trials or global optimality proof. B9 discrepancy cause and later request adaptation remain unknown; no later behavior changes this demand. Full interaction identification remains limited by unavailable legal link ablation.

summary.text: Intact candidate: inspect continuously from 0; trolley B4-B7 during 0-3 and B8-B11 during 3-6; hand carry B12 during 6-7. Inspection completion before unloading permits both full trolley loads. B9 requires correction during 8-10; B12 completes at 13. Prediction: nine source unloads, twelve correct sealed releases containing 120 brackets, seven occupied transfer minutes, thirteen inspection minutes and no rack wait. Any shortfall or transfer wait defeats this schedule prediction.

Closest operational rival: consecutive hand trips for B4-B12 during 0-9 with continuous inspection. Predicted completion at 13 costs nine occupied transfer minutes. Among complete successes, the intact candidate is preferred by its predicted seven minutes. This transport comparison preserves the P1-P2 connection and is not interface ablation.
